title_sq: Apartament 2+1, totalisht i mobiluar tek Ali Demi!
description_sq:
- Pjese e nje objekti te ndertuar ne vitin 2005, i mirembajtur, ne nje zone qe ofron te gjitha facilitetet per nje jetese komode.
- Apartamenti ka nje siperfaqe totale prej 110m2 te organizuar ne sallonin e ndenjes, ambienti i gatimit/ngrenies totalisht i vecuar, 2 dhoma gjumi, nje tualet me dritare, nje ballkon me pamje te lire dhe korridori qe ben shperndarjen e ambienteve.
- Disponon dokumentacion te rregullt hipotekor si dhe ofrohet totalisht i mobiluar si ne foto.
Per me shume informacion kontaktoni.
title_en: 2+1 apartment, fully furnished at Ali Demi!
description_en: - Part of a building built in 2005, well maintained, in an area that offers all the facilities for a comfortable life. - The apartment has a total area of ​​110m2, organized in the living room, a completely separate cooking/dining area, 2 bedrooms, a bathroom with a window, a balcony with a free view and the corridor that distributes the premises. - Has regular mortgage documentation and is offered fully furnished as in the photo. For more information, contact.
